title: docs/renode-workflow.md:60 version-verification line should name the tested Renode version
description: Review finding (woo7 round): the 'renode --version' sanity check says 'Expected: Renode, version X.X.X' without stating that 1.16.1 is the version CI validates and the fleet AMI ships (docs/simulation-infrastructure-deployment.md:47). A dev on nightly/brew-latest gets no divergence signal. State 'Expected: Renode, version 1.16.1' (or reference the pinned install step). Discovered from woo7.
